name: Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000/- (UG Students Only)
benefit: Under this scheme, tuition fee concessions (Freeship Tuition Fees) are provided to eligible students.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a 3-year undergraduate program or a 4-year veterinary program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar.
